description:
Police-recorded offences in Canberra by suburb, per calendar year for 2015-2024, by offence type.

Coverage: ACT: 115 suburbs; calendar years 2015-2024. Current to 2024-12-31. Full description, field list and method: `/v1/datasets/recorded-crime-act`.

**Price: 5¢ per call.**

fields.description: Comma-separated subset of: total_offences, armed_robbery, burglary_of_dwellings, burglary_of_shops, family_violence_assault, homicide, motor_vehicle_theft, non_family_violence_assault, other_burglary, other_offences, other_offences_against_a_person, other_robbery, property_damage, sexual_assault, theft_excluding_motor_vehicles. Omit for all.

suburb_name.description: Suburb name exactly as /v1/suburbs/list returns it, e.g. `Bondi` or `St Kilda (Vic.)`.

to.description: Last period to include, same formats as `from`.

name: suburbs_crime_recorded_offences_act
title: Suburb · Recorded crime (ACT)
